reviews.text: Jenni is awesome! She took my dog on daily, midday walk during a busy week. My pup is dog-reactive and she was great with her. Gives detailed updates. Knows the area too. Will definitely hire again.
Fantastic experience! Professional, communicative, flexible. I have been happily using their services without issue for over a year!

Jenni and Ary have been absolutely incredible with my chihuahua boy!! They are reliable, on time, and love my Elvis! He is difficult with other dogs on leash and they handle him beautifully. The communication is amazing, I get about 20 photos per walk with a full report. They will give discount to frequent users of walks as well. Only great things to say about People N Puppers

I’ve worked with Jenni and her team for about a year now. I needed a support for my anxious dog, a reliable sitter and regular walks. Jenni and her team were great about helping Luna acclimate and feel comfortable. Now when I take her to stay with Jenni, she’s always excited! She enjoys her regular walks and has really warmed up to everyone! Incredibly grateful to have them as a service and support for my Luna!
I’m so grateful for them! Very friendly, accommodating, and kind to my Golden Girl fur baby

Peoples n’ Puppers Canine Care provides excellent service for all doggy clients. I left my seven month old puppy (and all his antics) with Jenni for a multi-night boarding stay and was so pleased with her service. The nightly photo report gave me great peace of mind and Cooper even came home with new tricks in tow. 100% recommend!

We are so thankful! We have always struggled with finding dog walkers for our anxious English bulldog, but we can finally go away with confidence. They work so well with our dog, and they are great with communicating with pictures and a summary of how the visit went. I highly recommend!

Erick and Jenni are the best. My dog gets the best treatment and I get daily reports, letting me know what’s going on when I’m not there. They are super attentive to any change in my dog’s health or habits. You are so lucky to have found them!

The most bizarre experience ever.

I contacted several companies after my husband broke his leg and we needed short-term help with daily walks for our 2 dogs. I ended up choosing Peoples 'N' Puppers after I spoke via email with Jenni, who was very friendly and professional. We arranged a meeting with her and her partner, Erick. My husband met with them and described them as very nice people. We activated an account with their web portal and uploaded all the necessary paperwork. Jenni and I chatted briefly a few more times and once everything was set up, my husband went on the portal to reserve spots for walks the following week. He also texted Jenni regarding the possibility of a walk the next day.

Jenni, who had previously been very communicative via text, did not reply. My husband tried texting her again after a day or so, and still received no reply. Monday came and we'd heard nothing confirming the schedule, so he went back to the portal and got the following message:

Account is inactive for Peoples 'N' Puppers. Please contact your pet care provider to reactivate.

Say what? He tried again to text - no response. We waited about 5 days, and I tried calling both the cell phone number and the number on their website and got the message that "the number you are trying to reach is not available." ?!?!? Thinking I'd made an error, I tried multiple times - same thing. Finally my husband tried to call - his call rang multiple times, then went to a nondescript voicemail. So I guess she blocked me?!?

I don't know if these people are scammers or just really lousy communicators, but I have never had a professional services company ghost me before - and as a former dog walker myself, I cannot imagine leaving a potential client in the lurch like this without any sort of indication. I FINALLY just got the following email from her:

Good afternoon Kate,

We appreciate your patience.

At this time we’re unable to accommodate your request.

We wish you the best in finding a great dog walking service.

So, so, so sketchy. Complete waste of time, and now genuinely concerned that they were up to no good. Do not recommend.

Great communication and wonderful people who can handle a wide variety of dogs. Wonderful for our dog that there’s a great option for non-kennel personalized dog sitting and our dog had a wonderful time!
Jenni and Erick are the kind of people you can trust to take excellent care of your pup!
Our pup loves Jenni and Erick. They are so attentive to our boy and are super easy going. We love all of the pictures and updates after each walk!

I’ve been working with Jenni & Erick for years! They walk my pup regularly while I’m at work and she also boards with them once in a while when I’m out of town. Jenni & Erick are extremely knowledgeable about pet care, and they take their work very seriously, so I can rest assured that my baby girl is safe and happy in their care. They’re also some of the sweetest folks you’ll ever meet! My pup and I feel so lucky to have them in our lives : )
Wonderful experience for our dog. She felt safe and loved and happy!

The only person I trust walking and caring for my dog!! So skilled and knowledgeable,  I'm confident that they can handle any situation while I'm away. They give a detailed report after every walk and the numerous pictures they include are adorable and capture my dog's personality. They really pay attention and are in tune to my dogs mood and behavior. I feel lucky to have found such trustworthy people!
Jenni and Erick are amazing and our dog loves them and has a great time while he is with them :)!
Jenni and Erick are amazing! They are calm. They are responsible and they are so phenomenal with pets! I cannot recommend them enough. Just love working with them.

I’ve been using this Peoples n’ Puppers dog walking/boarding service for a few months now, and I couldn’t be happier with the care that Jenni and Erick provide for my dog. They offer regular walks and truly go above and beyond to make sure my dog is happy and well-exercised. Their reliability and attention to detail give me peace of mind knowing my dog is in great hands. Highly recommend!

Peoples N Puppers is now our go-to place for dog sitting & walks! Jenni & Erick are both fantastic with our pup and he loved them immediately. We felt extremely comfortable leaving him in their care, and he was very happy and content when we arrived home. They definitely went the extra mile, putting his coat on when it was cold, wiping his paws after a walk, and practicing his tricks. We loved seeing all of the pictures and video updates they sent throughout the day. As a former vet tech myself, it put me at ease to know he was in experienced hands. The app is also very thorough and makes communication easy, and we loved being able to see the checklist of everything he did on each outing. We’ve already booked an in-home stay with them for our next trip! Highly recommend!
Great with my 'difficult' doggo. Would recommend.
Jenni took amazing care of our dog. She sent pictures often and really made sure our anxious pup was well over while we were away.

I can’t say enough good things about People’s N Puppers. We needed someone to watch our high energy, 2 year old puppy over winter break. They sent me a thoughtful questionnaire to help learn about Rocket, had me visit to make sure it was a god fit, and then we were all set. While on vacation we received regular updates with photos that delighted us all, especially our kids. When we returned our dog was happy to see us but was also calm, proving to us that they created a happy, nurturing, loving environment for our puppy. We could not have been happier and are looking forward to using them for other vacation care for Rocket.
Peoples ‘N’ Pupper is a wonderful service. Very reliable and will come rain or shine! My dog absolutely loved Jenni❤️.
